dct_description_sm: The Northwest Territories (NWT) is recognized as a world leader in the successful co-management of wildlife resources. The responsibility for wildlife management is shared between governments, users and renewable resource boards set up under land claim agreements. The Department on Environment and Natural Resources is responsible for the implementation and enforcement of the Wildlife Act. The current Wildlife Act applies to vertebrates, other than fish, that are naturally found wild in the NWT. To inform programs, policies and environmental management; Peary caribou, muskoxen and Arctic wolves are monitored.
dct_title_s: Peary caribou, muskoxen, and Arctic wolves monitoring in the Northwest Territories
